title: EBM Audit evaluator manifests and receipts

PublicBatchCasePlan.$comment: Structured digest domain: ebm-audit/public-batch-case-plan/1. Natural identity: benchmark_subject_digest, authenticated_batch_sha256, case_ordinal, case_id. This public record owns shared case identity only and contains no held-out attempt, root, compiler, or sealed-manifest field.

ProportionalOperationPlanEntry.$comment: Structured digest domain: ebm-audit/proportional-operation-plan-entry/1. Contains pre-execution facts only.

ProportionalOperationPlan.$comment: Structured digest domain: ebm-audit/proportional-operation-plan/1. Natural identity: benchmark_subject_digest, contract_sha256, authenticated_batch_sha256, proportional_operation_plan_sha256.

PublicTerminalResult.$comment: Structured digest domain: ebm-audit/public-terminal-result/1. Natural identity is the exact case_operation_join_key. captured_run_sha256 is required provenance outside that key.

ReportSurfaceVerificationReceipt.$comment: Structured digest domain: ebm-audit/report-surface-verification-receipt/1. This post-render readback receipt is terminal gate evidence only and never re-enters the scenario owner manifest.

ProfileCharacterizationAnalysisSpec.$comment: The generic AnalysisSpec remains unchanged. This profile-only refinement applies the closed six-key pysaebm characterization settings schema and the exact nine-output characterization request to the nested backend object. The live selected subject reports fixed evaluation-cohort staging support, so the fixed evaluation-cohort stage outputs are required.

DevelopmentScenarioEvaluationReceipt.$comment: Unavailable in the current contract: development RuleOutcome evidence is not yet type-separated from held-out ScoreAggregateEvidence. A future Sol adjudication must define the producer-owned receipt before positive issuance.

FreezeUnavailableProfileCharacterization.$comment: An absence marker only. The future evidence receipt must be an opaque issuer-owned capability, not a caller mapping.

ScoreSourceValidationRegistry.description: The complete ordered expansion of the fixed score-source validation contract. Runtime equality, order, override, and handler closure checks are mandatory in addition to schema validation.

ScoreAggregateEvidenceDigestPreimage.description: The sole preimage for RuleOutcome.evidence_sha256 and non-baseline BackendGateResult.evidence_sha256. The authenticated score root commits the exact files and the source-validation registry commits their ordered validation meaning; the kind and ID select exactly one registered aggregate.

ScoreEvidenceBundleBody.description: Authenticated immutable upstream source bundle. Downstream score handlers operate on SubstantiveScoreContext, never on this bundle alone.

ScoreEvidenceBundleAuthenticationPreimag.description: Closed private-owner HMAC preimage with both derived authentication and root identities absent.

ScoreEvidenceBundleDigestPreimage.description: Closed score-root digest preimage carrying the already-derived private-owner authentication tag.

failure_class.description: Current runtime-owned typed failure boundary. Other malformed, missing, substituted, or incomplete inputs fail closed before a typed validation-failure record is guaranteed.

ConvergenceArrayArtifact.$comment: Exact local non-participant convergence array values. The evaluator consumes each convergence array exactly when its authenticated requested output owns it, including the boolean transition mask independently of order samples. It packs canonical little-endian C-order bytes and derives the complete array catalog entry; no supplied digest is accepted.

RootCommitmentReceipt.$comment: No current public phase may construct or admit a root receipt. A future version requires a proven durable acceptance CAS and a private-root owner.

RootCommitmentReceiptDigestPreimage.$comment: No current digest preimage exists because root issuance is unavailable.
